posts.trend: Gurugram woman spends over 50% salary on rent, shares why she wouldn't change it
posts.context: Urban rental pricing has ceased to represent shelter; it is now a security wall built against the collapsing municipality outside.
posts.angle: You aren't renting a bedroom. You are renting a temporary exemption from India's civil infrastructure.
slides: You are not paying for a flat. You are paying for a buffer.

Gurugram rent: 52% of your salary.
Security deposit: three months in advance.
Maintenance fee: ₹8,500.

The view inside: a gated park with two trees.
The view outside the gate: three miles of standing water.

You are buying the wall.
posts.caption: Send this to the friend who defends their rent by telling you "but the society has its own grocery delivery app."
posts.rank_verdict: It is highly accurate and painful for anyone who has lived in NCR, but the final slide is more of a sad geographic observation than an unexpected comic turn.
